about.tagline: Java Full Stack Developer | Laravel Backend Developer
about.bio: I am a passionate Software Developer with 2+ years of professional experience in backend web application development using Laravel and MySQL. I have hands-on experience in developing RESTful APIs, implementing new features, integrating backend APIs with frontend applications, managing databases, and resolving application issues. I have worked with technologies such as PHP, Laravel, JavaScript, Node.js, and React.js. I have also completed Java Full Stack Development training, gaining practical knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, React.js, and MySQL through project development. I enjoy learning new technologies, solving problems, and building efficient and user-friendly web applications. I am currently looking for opportunities to grow as a Full Stack Developer and contribute to real-world software projects.

projects.name: Resume Builder Application
projects.description: Developed a Resume Builder Web Application using Laravel and MySQL, allowing users to create, customize, and download professional resumes and cover letters. The application provides multiple resume templates, customization options, and subscription-based payment functionality.

caseStudy.challenge:
User Registration, Login and Authentication.

Resume creation and editing with multiple templates.

Dynamic resume sections such as Education, Experience, Skills and Projects.

Resume customization with different colors, fonts, layouts and background designs.

Cover letter creation and customization.

PDF generation and download functionality.

Free one-page resume creation with paid subscription options for additional features.

Admin dashboard to manage users, templates, categories, sections, banners and subscriptions.

REST API development for frontend and backend integration.

Payment integration and subscription management.

projects.name: E-Commerce Application
projects.description: Developed an E-Commerce Web Application using Laravel and MySQL, providing a platform for customers to browse, search, and purchase products online. The application includes customer management, product management, order processing, secure payment integration, and an admin dashboard to manage overall store operations.

caseStudy.challenge:
User Registration, Login and Two-Factor Authentication (2FA).

Product browsing, searching, wishlist and shopping cart functionalities.

Stripe Payment Gateway integration for secure online transactions.

3D product image integration for interactive product visualization.

Order management, order cancellation and payment handling.

Region-based product pricing.

Admin dashboard for managing products, categories, users, orders and suppliers.

Role-based authentication and authorization.

Artist/Seller registration and product management with revenue-sharing functionality.
